entries.en: There is a job, V. A journalist, Bree Whitney, has fled into Dogtown. I need you to look after her.
entries.ro: E o treabă, V. O jurnalistă, Bree Whitney, a fugit în Dogtown. Trebuie să ai grijă de ea.

entries.en: I look like a nanny to you?
entries.ro: Arăt ca o bonă?

entries.en: What's the gig, exactly?
entries.ro: Care-i gig-ul, exact?

entries.en: She fled? Means I gotta keep 'er tucked away?
entries.ro: A fugit? Adică trebuie s-o țin ascunsă?

entries.en: There is a corp on her tail, as she put it. That is all she said.
entries.ro: O corporație e pe urmele ei, cum a zis ea. Atât a spus.

entries.en: Where do I go?
entries.ro: Unde mă duc?

entries.en: Sounds more like paranoia.
entries.ro: Sună mai degrabă a paranoia.

entries.en: You'll go to her apartment first, on Skyline West. You're to collect an electronic access card.
entries.ro: Mergi mai întâi la apartamentul ei, pe Skyline West. Trebuie să iei un card de acces electronic.

entries.en: Askin' me to babysit?
entries.ro: Mă pui să fac pe bona?

entries.en: Huh. Think she actually dug somethin' up, or… is it just garden-variety paranoia?
entries.en_m: Huh. Think she actually dug somethin' up, or… 's it just garden-variety paranoia?
entries.ro: Hm. Crezi că a dat de ceva, sau… e doar paranoia obișnuită?

entries.en: Mm, one doesn't exclude the other. Besides, I wouldn't call discretion paranoia. It's a safety measure.
entries.ro: Mm, una nu o exclude pe alta. Oricum, discreția nu e paranoia. E o măsură de siguranță.

entries.en: Little too busy at the moment.
entries.ro: Sunt cam ocupată acum.

entries.en: I see. I'll send you the details nonetheless. Tend to it as soon as you can.
entries.ro: Înțeleg. Îți trimit detaliile oricum. Ocupă-te de asta cât mai repede.

entries.en: Don't have time for this.
entries.ro: N-am timp de asta.

entries.en: No. Bree has a lead. You're to help her complete her investigation.
entries.ro: Nu. Bree are o pistă. Trebuie să o ajuți să-și termine investigația.

entries.en: Contact me once this is sorted. You'll learn more details then.
entries.ro: Contactează-mă când se rezolvă. Atunci afli mai multe detalii.

entries.en: And no, do not say "This card – what's it open?" I simply don't know.
entries.ro: Și nu, nu spune „Cardul ăsta – ce deschide?”. Habar n-am.

entries.en: Ms. Whitney seems to have some minor trust issues.
entries.ro: Domnișoara Whitney pare că nu prea are încredere în nimeni.

entries.en: The reason, I would contend, why the client has yet to provide a rendezvous point.
entries.ro: Motivul, aș zice, pentru care clientul n-a dat încă un punct de întâlnire.

entries.en: Right. So where'm I meetin' this mystery-insistin' woman?
entries.ro: Bine. Deci unde mă văd cu misterioasa asta?
